title: Live viewport darkening root-cause diagnostic
posture: prove-first; no fix until live cause is proven

why_wrong: .viewer-panel-backdrop is transparent (background: transparent) so it cannot visually darken
it is a child of .viewer-stage only and cannot cover the right-side .viewer-inspector grid cell, yet the inspector is reported dark

static_findings.viewer_stage_background: #0b0e14 (near-black; shows through when canvas not painting)
static_findings.bim2d_plan_backdrop_filter: blur(4px) + translucent bg (darkens with the scene behind it)

captures: viewport host + canvas element + rect + center
document.elementsFromPoint(center) full stack with darkening styles + canvas relation + coverage
all full-viewport elements (any name) with styles
common-ancestor chains of 3D viewport / 2D plan / inspector
Bentley view state (viewFlags/emphasis/selection/displayStyle/background + canvas CSS opacity+filter)

live_capture_procedure: Open /viewer, sign in, enable Developer mode
Select Discovery MI -> PLACE IN MODEL -> DIAGNOSE — PLACEMENT ACTIVE (state B)
Cancel; while dark -> DIAGNOSE — AFTER CANCEL (DARK) (state C)
Compare A/B/C; read [ROOT-CAUSE CLASSIFICATION] + evidence sections
If a dimming element is ABOVE_CANVAS covering the viewport, toggle display:none in DevTools to confirm causality (diagnostic only)
root_cause_narrowed_to: ORPHANED_DOM_OVERLAY / COMMON_ANCESTOR_* (only if live elementsFromPoint/ancestor capture reveals a layer/shared dimmer not present in source)
next_after_proof: apply the MINIMUM correction to the proven owner only; add a regression (PLACE -> cancel -> IDLE -> no darkening element/state -> pointer reaches viewport); re-run suite/build/viewer
